Vendored: lib/xterm.js, css/xterm.css, LICENSE.

@xterm/addon-fit 0.10.0 — https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/addon-fit/-/addon-fit-0.10.0.tgz
tarball sha256 917ac44972453d5eed52edc1e50260c76398ce48cf2290c2e60671102bba0b33
Vendored: lib/addon-fit.js (as addon-fit.js).

Both MIT, both from the xtermjs org; the one LICENSE file above covers each --
they are byte-identical apart from the year, and a second copy of the same
text would only invite the two to drift.

The .js.map files are deliberately not vendored. They are larger than the
code, are only read when devtools is open on minified xterm internals, and
nothing in this app debugs into the terminal emulator.

Both are UMD bundles loaded with `defer`, so they hang off the global rather
than importing: `window.Terminal` and `window.FitAddon.FitAddon`. That matches
how KaTeX is loaded here and, more to the point, is the only shape these
packages ship in that does not need a bundler.
